description: xamops-service host-driven auto-provisioning: a DemoHostResolver component (reads the Host header, matches app.demo.host), the app.demo.host property wired across profiles (blank outside prod), and a demo-host new-user branch added to BOTH GoogleAuthController and MicrosoftAuthController that auto-provisions the user onto the shared demo client (ROLE_XAMOPS) and establishes a session (recording a LOGIN row via the existing path). Depends on FEAT-001 (needs Client.demo + findFirstByDemoTrue). The live signup-token path and existing-user path stay byte-for-byte unchanged.
steps: Create /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host/xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/service/auth/DemoHostResolver.java as a @Component: constructor @Value("${app.demo.host:}") String demoHost (trim + lower-case; may be blank); boolean isDemoHost(HttpServletRequest request) returns false immediately when demoHost is null/blank (local/dev fail-safe), else reads request.getHeader("Host") (Host ONLY, NOT X-Forwarded-Host), strips any ':port' suffix, lower-cases/trims, and returns host.equalsIgnoreCase(demoHost).

Wire the property across profiles following the existing ${ENV:} convention: in /Users/admin/.../application.properties add `app.demo.host=${DEMO_HOST:}` (blank default, near the app.signup-token.secret block); in application-prod.properties add `app.demo.host=demo.xamops.com` (near app.frontend.url=https://live.xamops.com); in application-local.properties and application-preprod.properties add explicit `app.demo.host=` (blank) so non-prod is visibly non-demo. All under /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host/xamops-service/src/main/resources/.

In /Users/admin/.../controller/GoogleAuthController.java: add `@Autowired private DemoHostResolver demoHostResolver;` (ClientRepository + PasswordEncoder already injected). In googleCallback, replace ONLY the new-user line (issueSignupToken -> /signup/complete) with: `if (demoHostResolver.isDemoHost(request)) return new RedirectView(autoProvisionDemoUser(identity, request));` followed by the EXISTING signup-token redirect unchanged. Add a private helper autoProvisionDemoUser(GoogleIdentity, HttpServletRequest) — a PLAIN private helper, NO @Transactional: race-guard re-lookup via userRepository.findByGoogleSub(sub) then findByEmail(email) -> if present return sessionService.establishSession(found, request, UserActivityEvent.PROVIDER_GOOGLE).get("redirectUrl"); else Client demoClient = clientRepository.findFirstByDemoTrue().orElse(null); if null log.warn("Demo host sign-in but no is_demo client is seeded; refusing to provision") and return frontendUrl + "/login?error=demo_unavailable"; else build User (setUsername(email), setEmail(email), setPassword(passwordEncoder.encode(UUID.randomUUID().toString())), setRole("ROLE_XAMOPS"), setAuthProvider("GOOGLE"), setGoogleSub(sub), setClient(demoClient), setLastLoginAt(LocalDateTime.now())), save, then return sessionService.establishSession(user, request, UserActivityEvent.PROVIDER_GOOGLE).get("redirectUrl").

Apply the identical change to /Users/admin/.../controller/MicrosoftAuthController.java using the Microsoft equivalents: findByMicrosoftSub, setMicrosoftSub, setAuthProvider("MICROSOFT"), UserActivityEvent.PROVIDER_MICROSOFT, and the Microsoft callback method. Verify the exact method/field names against the source before editing.

Create a unit test /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host/xamops-service/src/test/java/com/xammer/cloud/service/auth/DemoHostResolverTest.java: blank property => always false regardless of Host (AC-3); exact match true with and without ':port'; non-matching Host => false; case-insensitive match (AC-11).

Add or extend a controller-or-service-level test proving: demo host new user => NO signup token, user saved on the demo client with ROLE_XAMOPS and establishSession called (AC-6/7); non-demo host new user => signup-token /signup/complete redirect unchanged (AC-12). If the OAuth services are hard to stub in a slice, cover the branch at the autoProvisionDemoUser helper level with mocked repositories/sessionService.
acceptance_criteria: AC-3: with app.demo.host blank/unset, no request is treated as demo-host regardless of Host.
AC-6/7: a brand-new Google/Microsoft user on the demo host is provisioned without a signup token and without /signup/complete; they land authenticated.

AC-8: the auto-provisioned row has real email, provider sub, authProvider in {GOOGLE,MICROSOFT}, role=ROLE_XAMOPS, client=the shared demo client, lastLoginAt set (persisted username=email; real name shown via the header/profile endpoint).
AC-9: an existing user on the demo host does not create a new account; establishSession as today.
AC-10: a demo-host login produces exactly one user_activity_event LOGIN row via the existing establishSession path (no new audit code).
AC-11: DemoHostResolver is the single shared component used by both controllers.
AC-12/34: on live, a brand-new OAuth user still gets the signup token + /signup/complete; live login is unchanged end to end.
verification: From /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host run `mvn test -B --no-transfer-progress -pl xamops-service -am` — DemoHostResolverTest and the new controller/helper test pass; all existing auth tests stay green; context loads with the new property on all profiles.
findings: Host-driven demo auto-provisioning landed; full xamops-service suite green (Tests run: 3412, Failures 0, Errors 0; DemoHostResolverTest 8/8, GoogleAuthControllerTest 7/7 incl. 3 new demo-branch tests). SEMANTICS for later FEATs: (1) DemoHostResolver is a @Component at com.xammer.cloud.service.auth.DemoHostResolver; single ctor DemoHostResolver(@Value("${app.demo.host:}") String) normalises to trimmed/lower-cased; isDemoHost(HttpServletRequest) reads the Host header ONLY (not X-Forwarded-Host), strips ':port', and exact-matches case-insensitively. Blank/null property => always false (local/dev/test fail-safe); null request or missing/blank Host header => false. Both OAuth controllers inject it as the single shared detector (AC-11). (2) Property app.demo.host wired: application.properties => app.demo.host=${DEMO_HOST:} (near app.signup-token.secret, line ~702); application-prod.properties => app.demo.host=demo.xamops.com (right after app.frontend.url=https://live.xamops.com); application-local.properties and application-preprod.properties => explicit blank app.demo.host= . (3) In BOTH GoogleAuthController.googleCallback and MicrosoftAuthController.microsoftCallback the ONLY new-user-branch change is: `if (demoHostResolver.isDemoHost(request)) return new RedirectView(autoProvisionDemoUser(identity, request));` placed BEFORE the unchanged issueSignupToken -> /signup/complete redirect. The existing-user branch and live signup-token branch are byte-for-byte unchanged. (4) autoProvisionDemoUser(identity, request) is a PLAIN private helper on each controller (NO @Transactional): race-guard re-lookup (findByGoogleSub/findByMicrosoftSub then findByEmail) -> establishSession(..., PROVIDER_*) if present; else resolve demo client via clientRepository.findFirstByDemoTrue().orElse(null) and FAIL CLOSED (log.warn + return frontendUrl + "/login?error=demo_unavailable") when absent; else build User(setUsername=email, setEmail=email, setPassword=encode(random UUID), setRole("ROLE_XAMOPS"), setAuthProvider(GOOGLE|MICROSOFT), setGoogleSub|setMicrosoftSub, setClient(demoClient), setLastLoginAt(now)), save, then establishSession(..., PROVIDER_*).get("redirectUrl"). establishSession records exactly one LOGIN row via the existing UserActivityService.recordLogin path (AC-10) — no new audit code. (5) UserActivityEvent.PROVIDER_GOOGLE="GOOGLE", PROVIDER_MICROSOFT="MICROSOFT", ACTION_LOGIN="LOGIN". The demo client is resolved by flag (Client.demo==true), never by hardcoded name/id — consistent with FEAT-001. Write-gate extensions (Module 1.5), DemoClientMembership, billops endpoint, and frontend are NOT part of FEAT-002 and remain unimplemented.
